description: A React component class for rendering message attachments in Mattermost, including handling images, actions, fields, and modal previews.

classes.name: MessageAttachment
classes.description: React component for rendering message attachments with images, actions, and other content.

methods.name: renderPostActions
methods.description: Renders action buttons or menus for the attachment.

methods.name: handleAction
methods.description: Handles user actions on attachment buttons or menus, including executing post actions and error handling.

methods.name: handleCustomActions
methods.description: Performs custom actions like opening mailto links based on action options.

methods.name: getActionOption
methods.description: Finds a specific action option by name.

methods.name: getFieldsTable
methods.description: Generates a table of fields from attachment data.

methods.name: handleFormattedTextClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on formatted text within the attachment.

methods.name: getFileExtensionFromUrl
methods.description: Extracts file extension from a URL.

methods.name: showModal
methods.description: Opens a modal to preview a file.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, assembling all parts of the attachment.
